programs.title: Cybersecurity Maturity for the Defense Workforce
outcomes: Explain what CMMC maturity levels protect in DoD supply chains
Identify phishing and credential risks on the shop floor
Practice raising compliance concerns through proper channels

sessions.activity: Map the charter's mission to workers' daily tasks; discuss why AI governance and data protection are shared stakes beside the Potomac's defense corridor.
Read an Evidence Monitor summary on supply-chain cyber risks; small groups annotate real-world breach patterns affecting contractors.
Draft a mock worker-safety-and-cyber proposal with the Proposal & Grant Drafter; humans debate and vote; agent never enacts.
Review Progress Tracker metrics on training completion; workers set personal and local goals for the next quarter.

programs.data_shared: Anonymized quiz scores and common phishing-identification error patterns, aggregated with no names, badges, or employer identifiers.
programs.consent: Voluntary opt-in with signed acknowledgment; union stewards briefed; any participant may withdraw and have contributions deleted at any time.

programs.title: Agents and People: Governing Technology Together
outcomes: Describe how an agent-managed, human-governed DAO works
Distinguish tasks agents do from decisions reserved for humans
Practice respectful debate and voting on a class proposal

sessions.activity: Read the charter's six human-reserved actions; students sort scenario cards into 'agent can do' vs 'only people decide' piles.
Compare an Evidence Monitor summary with a news article; discuss what makes evidence trustworthy and summaries useful.
Students draft a class proposal (e.g., screen-time policy) modeled on the Proposal Forum; debate and take a final vote themselves.
Play the Task Router game: route paper task cards to the right working group and see how coordination works between votes.

programs.data_shared: Anonymous class-level tallies of card-sort answers and vote outcomes only; no individual student responses recorded.
programs.consent: Guardian/parent signed consent required before participation; teachers collect media and data permissions; students may opt out of any activity without penalty; no personal identifiers stored.

programs.title: Evidence-to-Advocacy: Using Synthesized Research Responsibly
programs.grade_or_level: Professional NGO staff and program leads
outcomes: Apply evidence-synthesis workflows to advocacy briefs
Understand human-governed decision cycles in DAO structures
Draft funding proposals for human review

sessions.activity: Workshop on turning Evidence Monitor and Research Synthesis Agent outputs into one-page advocacy briefs, with citation discipline.
Study the proposal cycle: agents draft, people debate and enact; teams outline a grant request skeleton for their own issue area.
Collaborator-mapping exercise inspired by the Collaborator Scout; build a stakeholder grid for a chosen campaign.
Define measurable outcomes for a pilot program and learn how the Progress Tracker reports against them.

programs.data_shared: Anonymized brief-quality rubric scores and common citation gaps, aggregated across cohorts without organizational names.
programs.consent: Organizational memorandum of understanding plus individual opt-in; data contributed only in aggregate; withdrawal honored on request.

programs.title: Mission Alignment for Nonprofit Teams
programs.grade_or_level: Nonprofit staff, board members, and volunteers
outcomes: Connect organizational mission to measurable public-good outcomes
Build simple progress dashboards for programs

sessions.activity: Compare the DAO charter's mission and contribution model to the nonprofit's own mission statement; draft two measurable outcomes.
Mock decision cycle: an agent-prepared draft proposal is debated and decided entirely by participants, mirroring human-only final votes.
Form working groups and route real tasks using the Task Router model; reflect on coordination without bottlenecks.
Build a lightweight progress tracker for one program; define indicators the board can review each quarter.

programs.data_shared: Anonymized outcome-metric templates and aggregated self-assessment ratings, stripped of organization names and beneficiary data.
programs.consent: Board-approved participation policy; individual written opt-in; no beneficiary data ever collected; removal from shared datasets on request.
